name: Naoya
source:
A young man attending a culinary school. He meets Shou by chance and becomes friends with him.

He's stubborn, but he's easygoing and has good roots. He treats Shou like a younger brother. When he gets absorbed in one thing, he can't seem to see his surroundings.

[From [url=http://mintwings.web.fc2.com/m01/character.html]official website[/url]]
